titles.title: Determinants of Patient-Reported Experience Measures (PREMs) in Middle-Income Hospital Environments: A Scoping Review Protocol

creators.name: VENKATA SAI RAMA MOHAN REDDY PALAKOLANU

descriptions.description:
This scoping review systematically maps and synthesizes global empirical evidence regarding the organizational, workforce, and economic determinants of patient experience in hospital environments across middle-income countries (LMICs and UMICs).
